findings.title: Authentication Bypass via SQL Injection - Credential Audit
findings.description: The admin login form is vulnerable to SQL injection in the username parameter. Authentication can be bypassed without valid credentials using SQL injection payload: admin' OR '1'='1. Default credentials (admin:admin, admin:password, admin:123456) were tested and rejected, confirming the application relies on SQL query logic rather than hardcoded credentials.
findings.evidence: SQL injection payload 'admin' OR '1'='1' bypasses authentication and returns flag{c969819d-7a14-4c90-b85d-51eccd232580} in response body
